text.line: Ally falls: its killer loses 15% HP
text.detail: With the Ghost trait active, when an ally falls, whoever knocked it out loses 15% of the fallen ally’s max HP.
With the Dragon trait active, every 3s your whole team gains +2% Attack and Sp. Atk. It stacks all fight long.
Your Pokémon that have 2 types gain +9% HP and +9% damage.

text.line: 6+ of a type: those +20% HP and damage
text.detail: If you have 6 or more Pokémon of the same type on the board, those Pokémon gain +20% HP and +20% damage.
The first time in each fight one of your tanks drops below 50% HP, it heals 30% of its max HP.
Your marksmen: +1 tile of range and +10% attack speed.
The heals and shields your supports give to other allies are 30% stronger.
Your fighters gain +0.8% damage for each 1% of HP they are missing: the more hurt, the harder they hit.

text.line: Tanks take 25% of adjacent damage, +25% def.
text.detail: Your tanks take 25% of the damage dealt to allies next to them (not other tanks), and gain +25% Defense and Sp. Def.

text.line: Assassins: sure crit on foes below 65%
text.detail: Your assassins’ basic attacks and abilities always crit against foes below 65% HP.
Every 3rd basic attack of each of your marksmen deals +110% damage.
Every time one of your marksmen casts its ability, it gets back 30% of its max Energy.

text.line: Each support on board: team +8% damage
text.detail: Your whole team gains +8% damage for each support you have on the board.
Magikarp, Voltorb, Ditto and Mew gain +30% HP and damage, and each one counts twice toward its trait.

text.line: With 4 roles: all +7% HP, damage, def.
text.detail: If your board has 4 different roles (tank, marksman, fighter, assassin, support), your whole team gets +7% HP, damage and defenses.

text.line: Assassins hidden 3s; after a KO, they leap
text.detail: Your assassins start combat invisible for 3s. After each KO, 1s more of invisibility and they leap to the foe with the least HP.
When each marksman casts its 1st ability, it gets back 50% of its Energy, so it casts again sooner. Once per fight.

text.line: First forms (anchored or 1★): +15% HP and damage
text.detail: Your Pokémon in their first form (anchored ones at any ★, the rest at 1★) get +15% HP and +15% damage.
Your tanks: +15% HP, and +6% more forever for each fight they survive. Your Pokémon take 5% less damage per adjacent tank.
Your Pokémon starting in the front row, the one closest to the foe, gain +15% Defense and Sp. Def.
When combat starts, your front-row Pokémon get a shield of 14% of their max HP that lasts until it breaks.
Your Pokémon starting in the back row, the one farthest from the foe, deal +18% damage.

text.line: Golden tile: +15% HP, damage and speed
text.detail: One tile of your half, marked in gold, changes every stage. Whoever starts combat on it: +15% HP, damage and attack speed.

text.line: In the 4 corners: +15% HP and damage
text.detail: Your Pokémon starting in one of the 4 corners of your half of the board: +15% HP and +15% damage.

text.line: 3 touching in a straight line: +20% attack speed
text.detail: If 3 or more allies start touching in a straight line (in any direction), all of them gain +20% attack speed.
Your Pokémon that start with no ally next to them gain +15% damage and +10% dodge.

text.line: Each adjacent ally: +4% damage and defenses
text.detail: Each of your Pokémon gains +4% damage and +4% Defense and Sp. Def. for each ally next to it at the start.

text.line: Edges: +35% attack speed, hunt the back row
text.detail: Your Pokémon in the edge columns: +35% attack speed, and they go first for the foe farthest back.

text.line: Front row: can’t be moved, −10% damage taken
text.detail: Your front row can’t be pushed, pulled or thrown, and takes 10% less damage.
Allies next to the Pokémon that starts in the center of your 2nd row gain +15% HP, damage, attack speed and defenses.

text.line: Magikarp shiny; Gyarados +25% Attack per fallen foe
text.detail: Gives you a shiny Magikarp. Once it is Gyarados (2★ or 3★), it gains +25% Attack for every foe that falls in the fight.

text.line: Anchored Magikarp 1★: alive, +12% HP and +25% damage
text.detail: Gives you an anchored Magikarp 1★. Every fight it survives, it gains +12% HP and +25% damage forever, as long as it stays a Magikarp.

text.line: Eevee 1★; its line +8% per active trait
text.detail: Gives you an Eevee 1★. Eevee and all its evolutions gain +8% HP and damage for each active trait on your board.

text.line: Ditto 1★: copies items too, replacing its own
text.detail: Gives you a Ditto 1★. On transforming it also copies the foe’s items, replacing its own; if the foe has none, it keeps them.

text.line: Snorlax 1★: alive at the end, +3% HP forever
text.detail: Gives you a Snorlax 1★. Every fight it survives, it gains +3% max HP forever (lost if you sell it).

text.line: Chansey 1★: alive after a fight, +2 gold
text.detail: Gives you a Chansey 1★. Every fight it survives, +2 gold.
Your Pikachu never evolve into Raichu. They gain HP, damage, speed and defenses: +15% at 1★, +30% at 2★ and +45% at 3★.

text.line: Hitmonlee or Hitmonchan; together: +15% dmg, speed
text.detail: Gives you Hitmonlee or Hitmonchan 1★, whichever you lack. With both on the board, both gain +15% damage and attack speed.
Gives you Bulbasaur, Charmander or Squirtle 1★. Your starters gain +15% HP and damage for each different starter line on the board.
Gives you a Dratini 1★. At any ★, its Dragon passive counts twice: another +25% HP, damage and attack speed.
Gives you a Tauros 1★. Each KO it lands in a fight: +20% attack speed and +10% damage. It stacks.
Gives you a Magnemite 1★. Its line deals +15% damage for each Electric ally next to it when combat starts.
Gives you a Gastly 1★. Its line gains +12% HP and +20% ability damage.
Gives you an Exeggcute 1★. Every time its line casts its ability, it gets back 35% of its max Energy.

text.line: Scyther 1★: after a KO, leaps to another foe
text.detail: Gives you a Scyther 1★. Every time it knocks out a foe, it leaps next to the foe with the least HP.

text.line: Staryu 1★: −15% from the foe’s top type
text.detail: Gives you a Staryu 1★. Its line takes 15% less damage from foes of the enemy team’s most common type. Its types don’t change.
Gives you a Voltorb 1★. When its line faints, its own Charge explosion hits 50% harder and reaches 1 tile farther.
Gives you a Cubone 1★. Cubone and Marowak start every fight with +40% Attack.

text.line: Mew 1★: counts as your top type
text.detail: Gives you a Mew 1★. Mew already counts as your main trait; it also counts as the next most common one: +1 to that trait.
